# forgejo-mcp: Forgejo & Codeberg Integration Substrate
> FastMCP 3.4.4+ server (v0.2.0 portmanteau tools, dialogic returns) with 12-view companion webapp: profiles, repos, issues/PRs, runners, inbox, chat, tools, skills, settings, logs, help.

## Architecture
- **Backend (Port 11133)**: Python/FastAPI backend proxy + FastMCP `/mcp`.
- **Frontend (Port 11132)**: React/Vite companion dashboard (Slate/Amber Dark theme).
- **Transport**: Stdio (Claude Desktop) and HTTP.

## Documentation
- [Primary Readme](README.md): Features, quick start, v0.2.0 tool surface.
- [Install Guide](INSTALL.md): Prerequisites and configuration details (in repo).
- [Onboarding](docs/ONBOARDING.md): PAT setup, pitfalls, port notes (in repo).
- [Agent Guide](AGENTS.md): Entry points and key files (in repo).

## Configuration
- [Pyproject](pyproject.toml): Python dependencies and build config.
- [Profiles JSON](.env.profiles.json): Dynamic profile tokens (gitignored).
- `FORGEJO_WEBHOOK_SECRET`: shared secret for `POST /api/webhooks/forgejo`.
